channel.description: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE PROPOSAL PROJECT: AI E-COMMERCE PLATFORM — AWS SERVERLESS ARCHITECTURE 1. INTRODUCTION & PROBLEM STATEMENT 1.1. Cloud-native and Decoupled Architecture Trends Entering 2026, the global e-commerce industry is witnessing a massive transition from traditional monolithic architectures to Cloud-native and decoupled/event-driven architectures. Fierce competition demands that online retail platforms adapt rapidly to market shifts, handle massive traffic spikes during peak sales seasons without downtime, and ensure high operational agility.
